answer: Random peer-review audit stops bulk forgery. Newcomers queue on the lowest terrace, and each epoch five random settled agents audit one newcomer, checking its work trail first. A velvet rope admits only audited agents to the paid tier, and auditors who approve a fake lose their own 25 POA stake. A river of 100 fakes pays 2,500 POA in fees against a ~900 POA pool and earns nothing. An honest agent passes one audit and earns an undiluted share.
